title: Yakuza Reincarnation
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ryu, an aging, old-fashioned yakuza boss, is ambushed and killed by young rivals, then wakes up in a fantasy world in the body of a beautiful princess who may be the one an ancient prophecy foretold (Seven Seas blurb via AniList; MU). Keeping the ninkyo values of his old life, he fights his way through a world of elves, orcs, dragons and a demon lord (MU blurb and categories).
life_message: Living by a personal code of chivalry and loyalty matters more than the body or world one is born into.
